gloss: to follow; to keep up with

definitions.gloss: to follow; to go along with
definitions.explanation: To physically follow someone or go along with them.

definitions.gloss: to keep up with; to keep pace with
definitions.explanation: To maintain the same pace or level as someone or something, whether physically, intellectually, or in a conversation.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}についてきてください。
{犬|いぬ}が{飼|か}い{主|ぬし}についていった。
{授業|じゅぎょう}についていけない。
examples.english: I can't keep up with the class.

examples.japanese: みんなの{話|はなし}が{速|はや}くてついていけなかった。
examples.english: Everyone was talking so fast that I couldn't keep up.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{歩|ある}くスピードが{速|はや}くて、ついていくのが{大変|たいへん}だった。
examples.english: He walked so fast that it was hard to keep up with him.

notes:
ついていく is a compound verb from {付|つ}く (to attach/follow) + {行|い}く (to go).

TRANSITIVITY:
- Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし})
- Pattern: [person]に ついていく

ASPECT (ている):
- ついていっている: in the process of following

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～についていく: to follow someone
- ～についていける: can keep up with
- ～についていけない: can't keep up with (very common)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ついていく vs. ついてくる: ついていく means to follow (going away); ついてくる means to follow (coming toward the speaker).
- ついていく vs. {従|したが}う: {従|したが}う means to obey or comply; ついていく is physical or metaphorical following.
